# Session 2: The Lighthouse

The party climbed to Greywatch Lighthouse at dusk. Inside, they fought three drowned sailors who rose from the flooded cellar. Dorran was badly wounded but Sefa healed him.

At the top of the lighthouse, Iska found the Sunken Key hidden behind the great lens. The Sunken Key is green bronze, cold to the touch, and hums near seawater.

On the way back to town, a hooded stranger watched the party from the cliffs and vanished before they could reach the path.

At the Drowned Lantern tavern, Captain Rhosyn Dace introduced herself. Rhosyn Dace leads the Tidebound guild, the smugglers who run the coast. Rhosyn Dace offered to buy the Sunken Key for two hundred gold, and Iska refused.

## GM notes

- The hooded stranger is Lady Maren Ashcombe in disguise.
- The Sunken Key opens the sea vault beneath Greywatch Lighthouse.
